differences.a_observable: Tighter camera framing on the central cards.
differences.b_observable: Wider camera framing with more visible background tiles.
differences.fix: Adjust camera position and focal length to match the tighter framing.

differences.a_observable: Warm cream color cast on the white surfaces.
differences.b_observable: Cool grey color cast on the white surfaces.
differences.fix: Adjust white balance to introduce a warm cream tone.

differences.a_observable: Deep shadows in the tile crevices creating high contrast.
differences.b_observable: Lighter shadows in the crevices with lower overall contrast.
differences.fix: Deepen shadows in the crevices to match the reference contrast.

differences.a_observable: Soft specular reflections of cards on the tile surfaces.
differences.b_observable: Matte tile surfaces with no specular reflections.
differences.fix: Increase tile material glossiness to enable soft reflections.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the white balance and lighting to correct the cool grey color cast in B to match the warm cream tone of the reference.

differences.a_observable: The yellow card has a reflective metallic finish.
